requested_scope: Six independent original ground materials for a shared-global-coordinate, 26 px cell terrain stitching system.

reference.role: Visual reference only: pixel cluster scale and dusty gray-brown/olive palette.
reference.input_mode: Inspected with view_image before generation. No screenshot pixels supplied in image_gen arguments; no UI, actors, road layout, tree or other screenshot content copied.

postprocessing: None. These files preserve the original generator PNG bytes. No programmatic substitute images.

files.exact_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original production diffuse ground patch for a 2D pixel-art RPG, intended to be sampled into 26-pixel gameplay cells and stitched with other patches by code.
Primary request: generate ONE square 1024 by 1024 opaque ground material image. This is a close local crop of walkable ground extending continuously beyond all four edges, NOT a landscape, NOT a whole map, NOT a miniature scene. The covered ground is approximately twenty by twenty human footstep grid cells. Each 26-pixel cell in the eventual game may contain just a few tiny pebble pixels or blades of low grass; no large focal object.
Reference role: the viewed Stoneshard road gameplay screenshot is visual guidance only for restrained hand-painted pixel clusters, dusty olive greens, gray-brown earth, and top-down RPG ground scale. Do not reproduce any UI, text, character, road layout, tree, or screenshot content.
Style and camera: strict orthographic overhead material texture; crisp visible pixel clusters and slight hand-drawn irregularity; low contrast; no photorealism, no 3D rendering, no isometric perspective, no painterly soft blur.
Lighting: completely even diffuse ambient light, no sunlight direction, no cast shadows, no vignette, no gradients caused by lighting. Full-bleed material with similar neutral gray-brown/olive color on all four outer edges; natural tiny details can continue out of frame.
Constraints: no border, no frame, no black margin, no transparency, no labels, no typography, no watermark, no grid lines; no people, no buildings, no ruins, no tree canopies, no bushes, no road, no path, no river, no water, no puddles, no embankment, no cliffs, no horizon. Keep objects very small and the ground flat and walkable.
Material theme for this independent patch: Gray Dike work camp: firmly packed dusty gray-brown earth that canal workers walk on, sparse fine gray crushed gravel, a few tiny dull olive grass tufts and minute leaf fragments. The earth is the main material; do not depict the workers, camp, equipment, canal, ruts or any site panorama.
files.generation_timestamp_note: The tool does not expose an exact generation timestamp; recorded immediately after successful return.

visual_review.note: Independent generated ground material, not a panorama. Exact periodic seams and regional blending remain the consuming stitcher's responsibility.
